<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916694_theRebbe_636" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916694_theRebbe_636__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Regarding the spirit of folly, a Jew who transgresses God's will is certainly no worse than a gentile who does so.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">[And regarding the spirit of folly etc. – certainly a Jewish person who transgresses His will is no worse than a gentile who transgresses His will.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Gentiles are on a lower level than Jews, yet the spirit of folly can cause them to deny God entirely, unlike Jews where it only conceals the Divine soul's wisdom.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And on the contrary: gentiles are on a lower level than the Children of Israel</t>
    <t s="1">(although from this perspective they are not worse)</t>
    <t s="2">– for with them, the spirit of folly can cover and conceal even the matter of "they call Him God of gods,"</t>
    <t s="3">so that they deny the existence of God entirely,</t>
    <t s="4">and not like with the Children of Israel,</t>
    <t s="5">for the spirit of folly of the kelipah "clothes the Divine soul up to the level of its wisdom,</t>
    <t s="6">but not including it,</t>
    <t s="7">because of the light of God that is clothed in wisdom"</t>
    <t s="8">(Tanya, chapter 24),</t>
    <t s="9">unlike gentiles,</t>
    <t s="10">who do not possess the level of wisdom of the Divine soul].</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The Tanya states that a transgressing Jew is far worse than the sitra achra and impure animals, but not worse than gentiles, since gentiles also have the spirit of folly to transgress.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Therefore: the language in Tanya chapter 24 is that "a person who transgresses His will is much worse and lower than the sitra achra and kelipah...</t>
    <t s="1">and more than all the things that flow from it in this world, which are impure beasts, animals, impure birds, creeping things, and reptiles,"</t>
    <t s="2">and it is not said that he is worse than gentiles – because,</t>
    <t s="3">from the aspect of the spirit of folly, even gentiles can transgress His will,</t>
    <t s="4">and only the sitra achra and kelipah and all the impure animals that flow from it,</t>
    <t s="5">for whom the matter of the spirit of folly does not apply,</t>
    <t s="6">cannot transgress His will at all</t>
    <t s="7">(and the example of this is specifically from the fact that "no harmful beast rules over a person etc.,"</t>
    <t s="8">for it is impossible to be otherwise).</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
